title: Research: connected E8 frame subfamilies need not saturate diagonal incidence
body:
## Result and exact boundary

347 genuine E8 frames on the fixed P107 live set have all 28 two-point
frame-intersection graphs connected, but their coordinate-2 diagonal-incidence
matrix has rational rank 43 instead of the required 44. An explicit +/-1
vector supplies an eighth independent kernel direction. This refutes
**(G) implies (D) for selected frame subfamilies**, not for the family of all
live frames.

The complete 877-frame family satisfies all eight required ranks. Adding one
explicit omitted frame, whose extra-vector sum is 2, already repairs all eight
ranks. No nongauge decoder, supplier, copied-information floor, physical
adoption, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. In particular this
does not refute the predecessor theorem, which assumes (D) independently.

- Entry and immediate refined-object overlap checks were run before computation.

- Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18915387.

## Files and verification

Only `research/e8-connectivity-incidence-boundary/` is added:
`README.md`, `TASK.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `VERIFY.json`, `CERTIFICATE.json`,
`verify.py`, `test_verify.py`. Frozen inputs and selected record are unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-connectivity-incidence-boundary --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-connectivity-incidence-boundary
```

Observed locally on Windows, Python 3.12: metadata/pins PASS; registered replay
PASS; 2 unittest groups PASS, including five semantic/receipt rejection cases.
Verifier output:

```text
PASS_E8_CONNECTIVITY_INCIDENCE_BOUNDARY live=877 selected=347 graphs=28 rank=43 required=44 canonical_kernel=7 extra_kernel=1 full_family_control=PASS one_frame_repair=PASS
```

Integer kernel identities supply exact upper rank bounds, modular nonzero minors
supply lower bounds, and the bounds meet. No floating point or predecessor
checker imports. A separate read-only AI review independently regenerated the
geometry/graphs and used Fraction elimination to reproduce selected/full ranks
43/44, canonical/augmented kernel ranks 7/8 and repaired rank 44. Its two minor
test-feedback items were addressed and the registered replay rerun.

## Remaining obligations and credit

The **all-live-frame-family** implication remains open and is the next question
in the README/TASK. No downstream rigidity, cost-floor or full multiplication
proof obligations are discharged. No full selected cold replay, independent
human review or hosted-CI success is claimed.

Prepared by **Aaron Wang / navinor, with help from chatgpt**. Substantial AI

Workflow feedback: the concrete-term recheck found the precise open handoff;
the annihilator-selected first vector falsified the broader implication without
a larger search. The supplied Python-3.12 path lacked a backslash: the working
path here is `C:\Users\warha\.local\bin\python3.12.exe`. PowerShell 5's default
redirection writes UTF-16; avoid it for JSON intended for UTF-8 tools. No packages
